definition: Careful to avoid potential problems or dangers.
example: He was cautious about making a big decision without more information.

definition: To allow something to leave a place or to be set free.
example: The company decided to release the new software update next month.

definition: To come nearer to someone or something in distance or time, or a way of dealing with something.
example: We need a new approach to solve this complex problem.

definition: A formal inquiry or systematic examination to discover and examine the facts of an incident.
example: The police launched an investigation into the mysterious disappearance.

definition: Not feeling confident or certain about yourself or something.
example: She felt insecure about her presentation skills before the meeting.

definition: The parts of something that are left after the other parts have been used, destroyed, or removed.
example: After the fire, only the remains of the old building were visible.

definition: The process of getting back to a normal state after an illness, injury, or difficulty.
example: The patient made a full recovery after the operation.

definition: To receive money, property, or a title as an heir at the death of the previous holder.
example: She inherited her grandmother's old house.

definition: To ask for information from someone.
example: I need to enquire about the train schedule for tomorrow.

definition: To convey a thought or feeling in words or by gestures and conduct.
example: He found it difficult to express his feelings clearly.

definition: Lack of satisfaction; discontent.
example: Many customers expressed dissatisfaction with the new service.

definition: To work together with someone else to achieve a common goal.
example: The two teams had to cooperate to finish the project on time.

definition: To help someone or something.
example: The software is designed to assist users in creating presentations.

definition: To discover or identify the presence or existence of something.
example: The sensor can detect even the smallest changes in temperature.

definition: To achieve or realize something desired, promised, or predicted.
example: It's important to fulfill your promises to build trust.

definition: To have a tendency or a natural urge to do something.
example: I incline to agree with her opinion on this matter.

definition: The action of hurting someone in return for an injury or wrong suffered.
example: He sought revenge on those who had betrayed him.

definition: To take on or start to use an attitude, plan, or way of behaving.
example: The company decided to adopt a new marketing strategy.

definition: To gain something, often by your own efforts, ability, or behavior.
example: He worked hard to acquire new skills for his career.

definition: Not able to be foreseen or known in advance; uncertain.
example: The weather in this region can be very unpredictable.

definition: A system of money in general use in a particular country.
example: The euro is the official currency in many European countries.

definition: A fact or condition connected with or relevant to an event or action.
example: Under no circumstances should you open that package.

definition: The inner part of something.
example: The interior of the house was decorated in a modern style.

definition: A prolonged public disagreement or heated discussion.
example: There was a lot of controversy surrounding the new law.

definition: In a slow, steady way; by small degrees.
example: The patient gradually recovered her strength after the illness.

definition: To take in or soak up a liquid or other substance.
example: A sponge can absorb a lot of water.

definition: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.
example: She showed great intelligence in solving the complex puzzle.

definition: To be entitled to a particular benefit or privilege by fulfilling a necessary condition.
example: You need to pass the exam to qualify for the next stage.

definition: To be unlike or dissimilar.
example: Their opinions on the subject differ significantly.

definition: The ability to produce offspring or fruit.
example: The fertility of the soil is crucial for good crop growth.

definition: To formally forbid something by law, rule, or authority.
example: Smoking is prohibited in all public buildings.

definition: To make something visible by uncovering it, or to reveal something hidden.
example: The investigation exposed a network of corruption.

definition: To make someone or something late or slow.
example: The heavy snow delayed the train by several hours.

definition: In a truly sincere or honest way.
example: He genuinely wanted to help his friends.

definition: The friendly feeling that exists between people who are together.
example: She missed the companionship of her old college friends.

definition: An event or occurrence, especially one that is unusual or unpleasant.
example: The police are investigating a minor incident that happened last night.

definition: Not ready or eager to do something.
example: He was unwilling to admit his mistake.

definition: Of or situated on the inside.
example: The company addressed its internal communication problems.

definition: Of or situated on the outside.
example: The building's external walls needed painting.

definition: To feel sadness, repentance, or disappointment over something that has happened or been done.
example: She deeply regretted her decision to leave the job.

definition: About to happen or appear.
example: The forthcoming election is generating a lot of interest.

definition: To regard as probable; expect or predict.
example: We anticipate a large crowd at the concert.

definition: Unable to be seen.
example: The tiny particles were almost invisible to the naked eye.

definition: To ask for information from someone.
example: I will inquire about the availability of the product.

definition: To fail or break down, especially a project or undertaking.
example: The business plan foundered due to a lack of funding.

definition: Able to be used or obtained; at someone's disposal.
example: The new book is now available in stores.

definition: Extremely important, because it will affect other things.
example: It is crucial to follow the safety instructions carefully.

definition: A careful examination or scrutiny.
example: The car passed its annual safety inspection.

definition: To conduct the policy, actions, and affairs of a state, organization, or people.
example: The prime minister's main duty is to govern the country.

definition: To bring back (a previous right, practice, custom, or situation); reinstate.
example: They worked hard to restore the old building to its original glory.

definition: To create or devise methodically (a strategy or a proposal).
example: The team needs to formulate a clear plan of action.

definition: To send goods or services to another country for sale.
example: The country exports a lot of agricultural products.

definition: To bring goods or services into a country from abroad for sale.
example: Many countries import oil and gas to meet their energy needs.

definition: To commit money in order to earn a financial return.
example: He decided to invest his savings in a new business venture.

definition: To express an opinion or reaction.
example: The professor asked students to comment on the reading.

definition: To distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose.
example: The government decided to allocate more funds to education.

definition: To adjust to new conditions.
example: It takes time to adapt to a new culture and environment.

definition: Having or showing an unfair tendency to believe that some people, ideas, etc., are better than others.
example: The report was criticized for being biased towards one political party.

definition: An innate, typically fixed pattern of behavior in animals in response to certain stimuli.
example: Birds build nests by instinct, not by learning.

definition: Acting or done in the same way over time, especially so as to be fair or accurate.
example: Her performance in the competition was consistently good.
